Show all 14 chain nodes defined in P82 validation shape: origin identity, bridge event trigger, bridge checkpoint, key-choice flag (medical_pure), entry variant A, entry variant B, decline path, currentGoal signal, lifeMemory signal, summary signal, origin identity preserved, composite gate key_choices dim 2 met, mutual exclusivity with merchant, mutual exclusivity with renown
Do not require full lifetime comparative exhaust
Proof does not rely on static shortcut as the only evidence
userStories.notes: Walkthrough of the full bridge chain — 14 nodes per P82 validation shape.
